answer: The supplied six-triple historical local reconstruction does not contain a direct protein-to-reaction statement: native matching finds zero triples from P00533 to Rhea 10596. It does establish an annotation-mediated attribution: P00533 core:annotation annotation SIP5F6B6005642E54E6 (typed Catalytic_Activity_Annotation), that annotation core:catalyticActivity activity SIP5A6CD89DB205C09A, and that activity core:catalyzedReaction Rhea 10596. The last statement is attributed to the activity node, not directly to the protein. No reaction-subject triples occur (native match count zero), and inspection of all six triples finds no equation or participant statements. Thus the fragment establishes neither reaction equation nor participants. This is a limit of this fragment, not a global absence claim; no live resource was queried. Supplied EGFR_HUMAN/full-name identity is historical fixture metadata, not RDF evidence.
